description: This file implements a RealtimeService class providing WebSocket and SSE fallback mechanisms for real-time communication, including connection management, topic subscription, auto-reconnection with exponential backoff, and message handling.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: A helper class for managing exponential backoff timings with jitter.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Provides WebSocket connectivity with JWT authorization, topic subscription management, auto-reconnect, and SSE fallback.

methods.name: withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method to create a RealtimeService with an external token getter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection (first WebSocket, then falling back to SSE if WebSocket fails).

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific topic; sends a message over WebSocket or updates SSE connection.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific topic; updates WebSocket or reconnects for SSE.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes current connections and stops reconnection attempts.

methods.name: _connectWebSocket
methods.description: Handles establishing a WebSocket connection with JWT token headers.

methods.name: _connectSse
methods.description: Establishes an SSE connection for fallback, managing SSE-specific message parsing.

methods.name: _emitParsed
methods.description: Parses incoming message data and emits decoded JSON or raw string to stream.

methods.name: _handleDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup and reconnection process after disconnect.

methods.name: _reconnect
methods.description: Attempts reconnection with exponential backoff, preferring WebSocket then falling back to SSE.

methods.name: _teardownWs
methods.description: Cleans up WebSocket connection and subscriptions.

methods.name: _teardownSse
methods.description: Cleans up SSE connection and subscriptions.
